headline: 7 killed as bus collides head-on with auto-rickshaw in Mymensingh
summary: The victims, including three women and a child, died at the scene after a Rajib Paribahan bus crashed into a CNG-run auto-rickshaw.
details: At least seven people, including a child, were killed in a head-on collision between a bus and a CNG-run auto-rickshaw in Mymensingh today.
According to Md Abdullah Al Mamun, additional superintendent of police in Mymensingh, three of the deceased were women and one was a child. All the victims died at the scene.
The accident occurred around 1:30pm in the Gandrapa area of Akua Bypass Road in the city.
A Rajib Paribahan bus travelling from Jamalpur to Dhaka collided head-on with a CNG-run auto-rickshaw bound for Muktagacha.
The auto-rickshaw was mangled in the crash, leaving seven dead. Police and rescue teams were dispatched to the scene following the report.
